study_identification_part.si4_title: Neurofind: using deep learning to make individualised inferences in brain-based disorders

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Introduce Neurofind, a freely available web tool that applies data harmonisation and normative modeling to structural MRI to compute an Outlier Index Score (deviation from normative morphology) and Brain Age; demonstrate exemplar applications in Alzheimer's disease and schizophrenia.

rci1_dataset_name.answer: HCP Young Adult; HCP Aging; UK Biobank; IXI
rci1_dataset_name.reason: The training/reference cohort comprises healthy controls drawn from four public datasets explicitly listed in the Methods.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: Data for training the web-based normative models used in Neurofind consisted of four publicly available datasets of healthy controls, namely the Human Connectome Project, the Human Connectome Project Aging, Biobank and IXI.

rci2_hc_n.reason: The manuscript clearly states the final preprocessed data for the train set comprised 3362 participants after exclusions based on age criteria (younger than 20 or older than 80), poor quality images (MRIQC probability > 0.7), and outlier removal. Table 1 also confirms N=3362 for the train set.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: The final data for the train set comprised 3362 participants (Fig. 1, Table 1, Supplementary Materials for sample size/scanner). ... Train set ( N = 3362)

rci3_hc_age.answer: Phase: Uninvestigated | mean: NR | sd: NR | median: 52.0 | iqr: 15.2 | min: 20 | max: 80
rci3_hc_age.reason: Table 1 reports the age as 'median [Q1, Q3] = 52.0 [15.2]'. The value 15.2 appears to be the interquartile range (IQR = Q3-Q1). The manuscript explicitly states participants younger than 20 and older than 80 were excluded, establishing the age range. Mean and SD are not reported for the age distribution in the train set.
rci3_hc_age.supporting_text: Participants with missing data and younger than 20 and older than 80 years old were excluded. ... Age, median [Q1, Q3] 52.0 [15.2]

rci5_imaging_modality.reason: Only high-resolution structural T1-weighted MRI was used for preprocessing and modeling.
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: The initial total sample included 13,918 T1-weighted MRI images from 7 scanners.

nm1_model_origin.supporting_text: The tool was trained on 3362 images of healthy controls aged 20–80 from publicly available datasets.

caa2_diseases_studied.reason: AIBL includes AD; MCIC and COBRE include SZ.
caa2_diseases_studied.supporting_text: The AIBL dataset includes patients diagnosed with AD... the latter two datasets include patients diagnosed with SZ...

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: AD shows large deviations from normative morphology with many high outliers and homogeneous deviation patterns; SZ shows fewer extreme outliers and more heterogeneity; both groups exhibit accelerated brain ageing.
